title: Implement immutable usage ledger and metering windows
summary: Implemented an immutable multi-tenant usage ledger with versioned meter and rate catalogs, explicit UTC and provider billing windows, idempotent event ingestion, bounded append-only corrections, privileged audited manual adjustments, pool-aware usage summaries, documentation, database protections, and concurrency/security regression coverage.

migrations: 20260904091000_create_usage_ledger.rb creates immutable meter definitions and versioned rates and non-overlapping usage windows and bigint append-only usage events with integrity triggers and tenant-scoped indexes
decisions: Meter definitions and rates are immutable and versioned with exact catalog synchronization
Provider-period meters require an explicit billing period and active immutable subscription context while calendar meters use UTC month boundaries
Corrections append opposite-signed events tied to the original context and cannot cumulatively overcompensate
Pool summaries aggregate compatible meter windows sharing the same pool and period and subscription snapshot
Raw idempotency keys and provider references are retained only as SHA-256 digests
risks: Durable quota reservations and their reserved balance source belong to prompt 040; the summary API currently accepts an explicit nonnegative reserved value
Provider reconciliation accuracy remains future billing-adapter scope
Table partitioning is documented but not enabled because correction integrity currently depends on a direct foreign key across billing periods
An unrelated existing identity test showed one timing-sensitive failure on an earlier full run; it passed in isolation and the final full suite passed
next_steps: Stop after prompt 039 as requested; leave prompt 040 eligible and unstarted
